[mattman] Sign up as normal in store.
You need to remain connected for 4 months or you have to repay a higher fee.
After 4 months you can cancel for 50% of remaining plan fees.
So..
$99 upfront
$69x4 for the 4 months
$34.50x20 for the cancelled 20 months
=$1065
To cancel afaik you can just port out to whatever Sim you normally use and Optus bill you whatever the outstanding amount is.
Tbh though at $34.50/month for a 5G 100Gb plan it's pretty competitive to just stay on the HN deal plan anyway. Given that you can still change/port out later if there's a real need.

[valkeris] @crackman: Sunk cost problem. Think of it as a $34.50 payment for the phone and $34.50 for the phone plan.
If you stay it's $69 per month and you get the value of the plan and phone but if you cancel you pay the $34.50 for 20 months to get out the contract (sunk minimum price of the phone) and then you don't get the value of the plan so have to go somewhere else for a phone plan.
If you can find a 5G 100G plan for under $34.50 then you are better off cancelling and taking the cheaper plan, otherwise you are better off staying on the Optus plan.

If I cancel after 4 months, the outstanding charges are no longer payable, so I would only need to pay the ETF. For example, $69 ÷ 2 × 20 = $690.
If I cancel before 4 months, there’s an additional $500 to pay back, rather than having to repay the base value of the Harvey Norman gift card. I’ve done this a few times, but I’ve never cancelled the plan within the first 4 months, so I’m not 100% sure what will happen.
